neighbours.label: sentence-initial 'Thus' (and more weakly 'Hence') that draws a conclusion from the previous sentence, as against other sentence-initial connectives and mid-sentence 'thus'
fire: The river carries silt from the mountains every spring. Thus the delta grows a little each year.
Copper conducts heat very well. Thus, it is often used in cooking pans.
The vaccine trains the immune system to spot the virus. Thus infected cells are cleared quickly.
The tax applies only to imports. Hence local farmers pay nothing extra.
Each cell carries a full copy of the genome. Thus any cell could in principle build the whole plant.
The bill failed in the senate by two votes. Thus, the old rules remain in force.
Light travels faster than sound. Thus we see the lightning before we hear the thunder.
The species lives only on one island. Hence it is listed as endangered.
quiet: The river carries silt from the mountains every spring. Meanwhile the delta shrinks a little each year.
Copper conducts heat very well. However, it is rarely used in cooking pans.
The vaccine trains the immune system to spot the virus, and thus infected cells are cleared quickly.
The tax applies only to imports. Instead, local farmers pay a land fee.
Each cell carries a full copy of the genome. Still, no single cell can build the whole plant.
The bill failed in the senate by two votes. Later, the old rules were changed anyway.
Light travels faster than sound. Yet we often hear the thunder before we notice the flash.
The species lives only on one island. Recently it was listed as endangered.

predictions: fire 0.35-0.6 on ' Thus' or ' Hence' opening a sentence after a full stop; ' However', ' Meanwhile', ' Instead' and mid-sentence 'and thus' below 0.08
